reviews.text: Love Noelle's business and our Beagle LOVES going to play-play (doggie daycare) with all his other fur friends.
Been using this business for over 8 years, you will never find a better place for your dog!! Always  the best service and care !! My dog loves going there !!

I am giving 3 stars because we were in a bind and Noelle took our 1 year old Puppy at the last minute. That was greatly appreciated but, came at a higher than normal price. I was charged $45/day, expected to bring my own food and bed. I understand about the food as not all food agrees with all dogs. Our Puppy came back to us with matted hair and poop on his whole back side.We were told He pooped in his bed, that we provided, which was brand new. Our Puppy has NEVER had an accident in his crate or bed or anywhere for that matter. He was completely potty trained at 10 weeks! We were charged $35 extra for a bath and he looked dirty, matted and smelled like a goat when we picked him up at 7:30 am. I am not ungrateful just angry. Noelle went out to “dinner (per her)” the night before we picked him up. I obviously cannot prove it but, I would say our Puppy was unable to get to his potty spot before he went to bed or he would have never pooped in his bed. To summarize, we will never reach out for boarding at this place again. I do hope this makes Noelle feel bad because our sweet little Guy feels … and smells like poop!!

Highly recommend. Very reliable and accommodating especially for last minute requests when life happens. My dog always comes home happy and clean. Also has in-house vaccination and grooming available.

My dog, the dog that doesn't like anything, LOVES this place. She starts whining with excitement when we turn down the street. She chokes herself on the collar trying to get in! She is always worn out when she come home. Thank you Noelle for taking such good care of her.

Highly disappointed that I had an appointment  for over a month and the groomer chose to wait until 2 hours before my appointment to verify my dog's vaccine records.  He is 2 months behind on one shot and she cancelled. While I understand the importance of having up to date vaccinations, and I take full responsibility for that, I don't understand waiting until 2 hours before my appointment to verify said records. I can't fix the problem in 2 hours. Been a client for 10 years, but won't be going back after this inconvenience.
Great place for doggie daycare and multi-overnights.  My dog loves it and the staff truly love dogs.  Nice that the owner is a vet-tech too!

Needed a place to board our lab while we flew out east for a week. Noele was quick and easy to communicate with.  Very convenient to have grooming done on the last day so she came home clean and happy. Plenty of time outside to play in the shade. It brought extra peace of mind that she was a vet tech. Would recommend to anyone!
Great set up for worry-free dog care!

Love how caring this place is!  They do christmas photos and take such good care of my pups when i’m out of town.  Reasonably  priced and Noelle is very knowledgeable about pets!  I would never leave my pets anywhere else.  Both also get grooming services by Giselle and I am very pleased with the way they handle/run the business 💖 …

I’m so glad I found Noelle’s services! My dog had such an awesome time playing at doggy camp with all his friends. The grooming services were amazing and I’ll definitely be back again. Leaving your furry family member here is a no brainer!!
Great grooming experience for our fur babies. They love going here.
Thank you, so glad we met your expectations!
I was worried about leaving my cattle dog, but said great and was there for a week. Also, the groomer was awesom
Thank you for your review. We aim to meet everyone's expectations.
Best daycare/ boarding/ grooming around! So glad I found Noelle and crew...Sadie loves going there!
